title: Kaadumale
overview: A woman's suicide attempt lands her in a mysterious realm where she meets a man haunted by a supernatural force. Together, they face the dark secrets of their forest prison as time runs out and malevolent powers close in.

songs.title: Kaadumale (Title Track) (From "Kaadumale")
songs.singers: MS Thyagaraja, Anuradha Bhat, D Shabdha
